design_philosophy: Modern, Minimalist, Premium, Clean Islamic Visual Touches. Blending modern web patterns with respectful, elegant aesthetics.

strategies: Use Playfair Display for Hero, Profile Headings, and major Section Titles to convey respect and heritage.
Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all body text, dashboard UI, and functional elements for maximum legibility.

layouts.public_site: Bento grids for highlights, generous padding (py-24, py-32) for sections. Soft shadows and glassmorphism for floating headers.
layouts.admin_dashboard: Sidebar layout, cardless or very subtle 12px rounded cards with 1px border. Density is tight for data tables.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-emerald-900/10 for header.
visual_enhancers.islamic_touches: Subtle geometric patterns as background watermarks in hero or profile sections (opacity 5%).

motion.entrance: Staggered fade-up for grid items (Framer Motion).

component_instructions.header: Sticky navigation, pure white glassmorphism, right-aligned CTA for Login/Contact.
component_instructions.hero: Left-aligned text with Playfair Display heading, emerald green primary button, gold accent secondary button. Right side: abstract Islamic geometric pattern or high-quality mosque interior image.
component_instructions.profile_cards: Respectful presentation: large image area, Playfair Display for names, gold accent micro-borders. Center alignment for portraits.
component_instructions.admin_sidebar: Emerald green background with white text, or white background with emerald active states.
component_instructions.data_tables: Shadcn UI tables, clear borders, pagination, robust search/filter header.

image_urls.description: Ornate dome interior with gold accents, use as hero visual or background accent.
Respectful portrait placeholder for Pendiri/Penerus if needed, or use abstract architecture.
Muslims gathered for prayer, shows unity.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for elegant, modern iconography.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism.
Use sonner for toast notifications, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header or overlays. Ensure readability with proper backdrop blurs.
Share guidelines for .js files, NOT .tsx files.
